reviews.text: This shop is a real disgrace. The service is terrible, everyone's always grumpy, you pick up a package and it's full of hair, and on top of that, they close whenever they want and never respect the opening hours. I think the temporary closure is hiding something. So, to answer the gentleman below, I went there several times, well before the closure, and I stopped going... the staff are haughty, barely polite. It's a good thing it's closed; we don't need people like that in our neighborhood.
The store is no longer at this address.

Excellent experience for my little one! A dynamic and friendly team combined with impeccable professionalism! I'm delighted, and my little Yorkie has never looked so handsome! I highly recommend them 💖 …

A grooming appointment that turned into a nightmare. I took him in for a €65 grooming session, and my poor dog was in a terrible state, with very deep cuts, one of which became infected. My dog ​​will never set foot in that torture chamber again!!! Avoid at all costs!!!
Too much waiting in front of the store door on the sidewalk summer and winter even in the rain and of course you shouldn't expect a hello and see.

I often pick up my parcels at this collection point, and I'm always satisfied! Last time, something came up, and they kindly agreed to hold my parcel a little longer after I called. The staff are always welcoming and friendly. I even went with my dog, who loved the shop too! I highly recommend this collection point.

I've always received a very warm welcome, and I thank them for that. The team is attentive and always smiling. They professionally check the person collecting the packages. I don't have a dog, but I've only heard good things about their services. So, let's go!
You pick up your package on the sidewalk, and you have to show your ID in the street! I've never seen a parcel pickup point operate like this; I'll never use it again.
